title: Show 'Now Playing' Header
description: Display cute '♪ Now Playing' label above the song title.

title: Header Label Text
description: Custom text for the top label (default: Now Playing).

title: Text Alignment
description: Horizontal alignment of the Now Playing text.

title: Layout Style
description: Stacked (2 Lines: Title on top, Artist + [Diff] below) or Single Line (Artist - Title [Diff]).

title: Show [Difficulty]
description: Display the beatmap difficulty name in brackets [Difficulty].

title: Use Original Language (Unicode)
description: Show original Japanese/Korean/Chinese titles instead of Romanized English.

title: Cute Font Style
description: Choose a cute, clean rounded font style.

title: Title Font Size [px]
description: Font size of the song title in pixels (default: 26).

title: Artist & Difficulty Font Size [px]
description: Font size of the artist and difficulty line in pixels (default: 17).

title: Text Shadow / Readability
description: Soft drop shadow behind text so it stays readable on any background.

title: Max Text Width [px]
description: Maximum width before long titles smoothly scroll (default: 720).

title: Transition Duration [ms]
description: Smooth blur + fade transition speed when changing songs (default: 550).

title: Gameplay Only
description: Only show Now Playing during gameplay (hide in song selection / menu).
